# Yahoo! JAPAN

> Yahoo! JAPAN is Japan's leading digital services portal offering search, e-commerce, auctions, and membership benefits integrated with PayPay rewards and LINE ecosystem.

Yahoo! JAPAN provides comprehensive online services tailored to Japanese users, including search with AI assistance, shopping with PayPay cashback integration, auctions, and premium membership programs. The platform emphasizes real-time trends, exclusive promotions, and seamless payment integration through its PayPay partnership.

## Search & Discovery

- [Yahoo! Search](https://search.yahoo.co.jp): Japanese search engine with web, image, video, and real-time trends
- [Yahoo! Search with AI Chat](https://search.yahoo.co.jp/aichat): Yahoo! Search with AI assistant, images, videos, news, and real-time trends

## Shopping & Commerce

- [Yahoo! Shopping](https://shopping.yahoo.co.jp): Online shopping mall with PayPay rewards and exclusive daily deals
- [Yahoo! Auctions](https://auctions.yahoo.co.jp): Japan's largest online auction and freemarket trading platform
- [Super PayPay Festival](https://shopping.yahoo.co.jp/promotion/sale/ppf): Limited-time PayPay festival promotion with up to 22% cashback rewards
- [ZOZO Festival](https://shopping.yahoo.co.jp/promotion/campaign/zozo_fes): ZOZO festival promotion with fashion items and PayPay cashback

## Membership & Rewards

- [LYP Premium Membership](https://premium.yahoo.co.jp): LYP Premium membership with PayPay points and LINE integration benefits
- [Yahoo! Treasure Box](https://takarabako.yahoo.co.jp): Exclusive coupon lottery and PayPay point rewards promotion

## Internet Services

- [SoftBank Air Wi-Fi](https://bbpromo.yahoo.co.jp/softbank-air): SoftBank Air home Wi-Fi service promotion with ¥25,000 cashback

## Family & Kids

- [Yahoo! Kids](https://kids.yahoo.co.jp): Safe children's portal with educational content and learning resources
